test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Personal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Personal **means relating to an individual's private life, feelings, and thoughts. (व्यक्तिगत)

 
 
• **Example**: *The security breach caters to the vulnerability of personal data online.*
 
 
 
• In this context, '**personal**' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, 'personal' is an adjective that modifies the noun 'life'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Political **refers to activities related to government or public affairs. (राजनीतिक)
 
• **Public **refers to things that are open or accessible to everyone, or related to the government or society. (सार्वजनिक)
 
• **Personnel **refers to employees or staff members of an organization. (कर्मचारी वर्ग)
